title: Atlas Intelligence Metadata Schema v1
description: Canonical schema for intelligence-layer metadata attributes assigned to Atlas dataset records. This metadata is stored separately from canonical records and never modifies the immutable dataset.

difficulty_level.description: Difficulty level per Atlas Difficulty Taxonomy v1: 1=Basic, 2=Intermediate, 3=Advanced, 4=Expert, 5=Research.

confidence_score.description: Confidence in the assigned difficulty level. 0.0=no confidence / insufficient evidence, 1.0=certain.

reasoning_type.description: Primary reasoning type exhibited by the record.

skill_domain.description: Skill domain to which the record's knowledge primarily belongs.

classification_source.description: Method used to produce this classification. 'classifier' = automated model scoring, 'manual' = human review, 'rule_based' = deterministic heuristics.

record_id.description: Foreign key to the canonical dataset record ID. Must match exactly.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why this level was assigned.

reasoning_types.description: Ordered list of reasoning types detected (primary first).

skill_domains.description: Skill domains relevant to this record (primary first).

classified_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this classification was produced.

classifier_version.description: Version of the classifier or rule set that produced this classification.

features.description: Optional computed features used during classification (for audit / debug).

vocabulary_density.description: Ratio of unique technical tokens to total tokens.

reasoning_steps_estimate.description: Estimated number of distinct reasoning steps.

code_fraction.description: Fraction of answer content that is code or pseudocode.

cross_domain_flag.description: True if the record references multiple skill domains.

review_status.description: Human review status for this classification record.
